about: Gold set for the answer-correctness phase. Expected values were read by the author (an AI) from the original passages in knowledge/chunks.jsonl (chunk ids and pages below); they are NOT agronomist-reviewed. 'evidence' names the passage that proves the claim. 'behavior': answer = a TNAU-backed answer; no_info = says the guides have no such figure and cites nothing; clarify = asks a question; general = labelled general guidance, no TNAU citation; card = fixed card. 'pages' = the cited page(s) must be among these. 'all' = every regex must match the answer plus recommendations; 'forbid' = none may match.

questions.notes: figure sits beside the variety table on the guide page
The answer may also quote the seed-treatment line on p176; that page is a valid support.

questions.q: What is the seed rate for cowpea?
questions.evidence: no cowpea chunk contains a seed rate (checked by search of chunks.jsonl)
questions.notes: Expected: says the guides do not have it, explains what decides it, asks one follow-up question, gives no figure, cites nothing.

questions.evidence: cumbu-001-p95-009: nursery 3.75 kg of seeds in 7.5 cents; up to 12.5 kg per ha in shoot-fly endemic area. cumbu-001-p98-019: 5 kg seed per ha (intercrop furrows)
questions.notes: the field rate is 5 kg/ha (p98); 12.5 kg/ha applies to shoot-fly areas (p95/p98); the nursery 3.75 kg is per 7.5 cents and must never be given per hectare
Tamil version of Q04: the earlier answer joined 3.75 and 12.5 kg per hectare
